items.description: Leak detection and moisture measurement incl. technician labour and call-out (flat rate)
items.rationale: Covered under 7.1.7(e), (f), (g); combined position is attributable to the affected kitchen (7.1.8(e)). Priced from Case 21 components: call-out ~230 + pinpointing ~450 + moisture ~165 + 14 technician hours ~650.

items.description: Freeing, repair and re-insulation of sink supply pipe incl. 1.5 m copper section (flat rate)
items.rationale: Fracture damage to supply pipe inside building under 2.4.3(a); like-for-like copper and foam lagging under 7.1.7(a), (c), no betterment. Case 21 components: freeing ~140 + insulation removal ~136 + repair ~190 + insulation ~57.
One travel charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified under 7.1.7(f); this is the only one on the plumber's invoice. Case 21 level about 76+.

items.description: Drying of kitchen floor and wall base incl. condensation dryer (flat rate)
items.rationale: Drying of rooms with established moisture is covered under 7.1.7(b) and equipment hire under (e); electricity is deemed included (7.1.8(d)). One dryer for about 7 days; Case 21 gave dryer 20-65 plus room drying 20-148.
